title: Ivo and the Weather
author: Mirabel Quintana
blurb: Ulyana Quintana, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
